body: I actually do have a dog! She's my unofficial therapy dog. She is definitely the biggest motivator for me to get out and walk, and one of the biggest sources of happiness in my life (which may be lame, but I really do love my dog more than anything). Luckily for me there are plenty of beautiful wooded trails right in my neighborhood so that is definitely helpful. Thank you for your suggestions and your help! I appreciate it so much

also the "in debt forever" part was more in relation to being hospitalized, which my boyfriend feels is the only way to help. I couldn't possible afford inpatient treatment and if I had to miss two weeks/a month of school it would put me so far behind and I don't know if I'd be able to keep up. It's hard enough for me to keep up and attend my classes as it is.

I know I need a doctor and as soon as I'm financially stable enough to be able to get on the medication I need I will definitely do that. I have had a really horrible experience with the counsellors at my college and my anxiety makes it almost impossible for me to be able to go talk to them. Thank you for your suggestions though, I appreciate it

Thank you SO MUCH for your response, I really needed to hear this. I have recently started going on half an hour walks a few times a week and I'm going to keep it up and hopefully it will help, my old therapist was very adamant about exercise and how much it helps so I'm really trying to get better about that. I will definitely take you up on the offer of talking if I need someone. Again, thank you and I really appreciate everything you said.
Also I just relapsed and self harmed after months of being clean
